$comment: Every item of the game (spec §6.4), checked by tools/lib/validate-items.mjs. key = needed for an ending: never thrown, consumed, offered or destroyed (only dropped, or spent by the step that uses it). metal / electronic: what scouts and the Mangrove Gatherer react to when held or carried. offering = a non-metal thing a scout accepts at a border totem. stack = most per hotbar slot (1 for tools and devices). use: drink {amount} | heal {amount, stopsBleed} | toggle (power on/off) | throw | none.

items.name: Paracord
items.description: Thirty metres of orange nylon cord, still strong.

items.name: Waterproof tarp
items.description: A folded blue tarp, big enough to patch a hull.

items.name: Driftwood
items.description: A dry, straight length of sea-bleached wood.

items.name: Crowbar
items.description: Rusted steel. It will open a jammed hatch, and it shows.

items.name: Radio battery
items.description: A sealed marine battery with some charge left.

items.name: Flare gun
items.description: An orange signal pistol from the wreck's locker.

items.name: Flare casings
items.description: Spare signal cartridges in a waxed pouch.

items.name: Coconut
items.description: Green and heavy. Water inside; a dull thud when thrown.

items.name: Reef shell
items.description: A pale spiral shell from the reef flats.

items.name: Bone
items.description: Old and sun-whitened. Better not to ask whose.

items.name: Fish
items.description: A reef fish, fresh enough to give away.

items.name: Healing herbs
items.description: Bitter leaves bound with grass. They close a wound.

items.name: Rock
items.description: Fist-sized. Thrown, it draws ears away from you.

items.name: Flashlight
items.description: Your own torch. Light in the dark, and something else notices.

items.name: Tin flask
items.description: The freighter sailor's dented flask, long empty.

items.name: Driftwood totem
items.description: Wood, cord and shell bound the way Marek showed you.
